conditions: The assertion concerns the two alternatives of the ordinary disjunctive pattern form in §7.5.
limitations: The captured F# 4.1 working document records May 2018 updates, omits some F# 4.1 RFCs, and warns of implementation discrepancies. Other RFCs, releases, and compiler behavior require separate evidence.

The adjacent example’s prose gives a Boolean result whereas the displayed function returns options. The assertion uses the separate rule text and leaves guard and active-pattern behavior outside this scope.

triggers: A changed publisher representation, applicable omitted RFC, source correction or contrary scoped evidence.

statement: The F# 4.1 working specification describes trying the left alternative of an ordinary disjunctive pattern first and trying the right alternative if the left fails. Both alternatives must bind the same set of variables with the same types.
